title: a concept keeps one identity from first idea to what got built

criteria.text: One identity: a concept's id never changes; names are listed with dates and the ruling behind each; a refused name stays refused
Typed events: ten event types, each with a date, evidence and the PM's words in their own field
Lineage holds: split, merged and became links between concepts, scenarios and ideas still resolve after a file is deleted
criteria.note: Four lineage link types (#1233) [V]. Checked: `[guards F130.3]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_concepts.sql`.

criteria.text: Proven on real history: Posts (from Bulletins) and Open your town load with the brief's timelines, entry for entry
criteria.note: `concepts-seed.json` holds both timelines (#1233; the test reads the real brief in CI) [V]. Checked: `[guards F130.4]` in `tests/knowledge-concepts.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Ideas move in: each of IMAGINE.md's ideas becomes a concept with status idea
criteria.note: Import creates the ideas (#1233; story-map placement #1331) [V]. Checked: only `[guards F130.5 partial]` in `tests/knowledge-concepts.test.ts`.

Not built [V]: socialus-plan `IMAGINE.md` still lists its ideas (42 `CO-` lines on 2026-11-20); #1233 PR body: 'removal ... socialus-plan's half, done by the parent session'. This is socialus-plan work.

criteria.text: Scenarios join their concept: a scenario names its concept in frontmatter and the import links them
criteria.note: Import reads `concept:` frontmatter (#1233; `concept: new` #1251) [V]. Checked: only `[guards F130.6 partial]` in `tests/knowledge-concepts.test.ts`.

criteria.text: A scenario touched after this ships without a concept fails lint
criteria.note: Not built [V]: no concept check in socialus-plan `scripts/*.py`; #1233 PR body leaves it to socialus-plan.

criteria.text: One call answers it: "how did this concept change and why" is one lookup call
Drift is found: a weekly check lists concepts whose built and ruled states disagree and docs that still call something cut after it came back
criteria.note: `knowledge-drift.yml` opens one Issue (#1345 is its latest, open; it lists 3 stale 'Bulletins, cut' lines in socialus-plan) [V]. Checked: only `[guards F130.8 partial]`.
